priorDirectorDisposition.note: The new fixture addresses the state, reversible evidence, locator and count findings. No finding is marked closed until the Director rechecks this revision.

forkExtension.limitation: These branch inventory premises extend the preserved final snapshot only; they do not alter the source case or assert an actual campaign transit/history.

testOnlyInputs.durationStatus: UNADJUDICATED_TEST_ONLY_INPUT; no bound accepted source specifies a short-rest minimum duration.
testOnlyInputs.shortRestEligibility: UNADJUDICATED; this fixture ends a candidate interval and does not assert a qualifying completed rest.
testOnlyInputs.safety: No hostile creature/hazard is present during the hypothetical interval; this is a fixture premise and does not imply Fortress grants safety.
testOnlyInputs.noInterruption: TEST_ONLY premise: no attack, labor, travel, casting or Weave ability during the candidate interval.
testOnlyInputs.consumption: Each inventory item records quantityConsumed=0 and quantityRemaining=1. This is a deliberate no-consumption claim, because no bound consumption rule is supplied; the Director must not infer that the supplies legally suffice for rest.
testOnlyInputs.noOtherRecovery: No Arcane Recovery, meditation, Retune, long-rest recovery, or other RP source is applied while eligibility is unadjudicated.

conditionalCalculation.eligibility: UNADJUDICATED; no state transition is authorized from this arithmetic alone.
conditionalCalculation.RetuneIfQualified: 0 remains 0; this is not an additional RP award.
